scope: Installed native browser exports, software rendering correctness and bounded measurement evidence. No hardware frame-rate gate is claimed.

reproduction.build: node native/game/browser/build.mjs --sdk <pinned-emsdk-directory> --build-dir <temporary-build-directory> --output-dir packages/game-renderer/dist && npm run build:packages
reproduction.profile: Explicit selfcheck requires staged profile and sets NODETOOL_NATIVE_BROWSER_PROFILE=1. Ordinary package suites omit actual-module integration when the profile is absent.
reproduction.inputDigestMethod: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON.stringify(measuredInputs), using the stored property order. Document and artifact digests hash exact exported bytes.

2d.method: fresh browser process/context/page navigation to first completed canvas frame, then restart checks and 120 event-timestamped samples with benchmark=1 canvas CPU+GPU synchronization; HTTP gzip default per file including compression cost; OS caches uncontrolled
2d.frameScope: canvas CPU and GPU completion, excludes DOM compositor, display and GPU-only timing

firstSample.nativeCompletionScope: canvas CPU+GPU completion, excludes DOM compositor/presentation

diagnostics.nativeCompletionScope: canvas CPU+GPU completion, excludes DOM compositor/presentation

2d.memoryMethod: WASM linear-memory extent sampled after dispatch, excludes live allocation, GPU and JS heaps

3d.method: fresh browser process/context/page navigation to first completed canvas frame, then restart checks and 120 event-timestamped samples with benchmark=1 canvas CPU+GPU synchronization; HTTP gzip default per file including compression cost; OS caches uncontrolled
3d.frameScope: canvas CPU and GPU completion, excludes DOM compositor, display and GPU-only timing

firstSample.nativeCompletionScope: canvas CPU+GPU completion, excludes DOM compositor/presentation

diagnostics.nativeCompletionScope: canvas CPU+GPU completion, excludes DOM compositor/presentation

3d.memoryMethod: WASM linear-memory extent sampled after dispatch, excludes live allocation, GPU and JS heaps

negativeWitnesses.exportAdmission: Omitting the installed WASM validate dispatch makes the QuickJS syntax, expanded prefab collision, and unsupported 2D physics cases fail. Restoring it rejects all three before publication with no output or sibling staging.
negativeWitnesses.profileAbsent: With native-game.wasm temporarily removed, profile-off native browser suites passed. The explicit browser selfcheck failed with an unavailable-profile error. The file was restored in finally.
negativeWitnesses.emptyDiscovery: The browser selfcheck rejects an empty fixture directory.
negativeWitnesses.runtimeAndAssets: Missing capability, altered runtime bytes, altered owned assets, traversal, existing destinations and cancellation are rejected.
negativeWitnesses.sourceDrift: The generated bundle check rejects stale artifact identity.

limitations: WASM memory values are linear-memory extent, not live allocation or process RSS.
Decoded asset memory, GPU asset memory, isolated script latency and isolated GPU-only timing are not instrumented.
Canvas completion uses opt-in gl.finish and excludes the DOM compositor and display presentation.
Startup uses a fresh browser process/context/page and measures navigation to the first completed canvas frame. OS caches are uncontrolled.
Each dimension has one startup observation and 120 timestamped steady canvas-completion samples after restart checks. Results are not statistical startup distributions.
SwiftShader is a software renderer. These measurements do not establish a hardware frame-rate budget.
